business_summary: TYK Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of functional refractories and ceramics worldwide. It offers converter, pig iron ladles, secondary refining, gas blowing, flow control systems, large precast blocks, lance pipes, blast furnace, continuous casting, cement kiln and lime kiln, incinerator and industrial furnace, and auxiliary machinery and equipment. The company also provides graphite crucibles, lining for induction furnace, ceramics gas sensor, shot sleeves for aluminum alloy die-casting, fused silica, aluminum titanate ladles, and rotary gas bubbling products. In addition, it offers Advanced Materials, such as fine ceramics, abrasion-resistant materials, composites, ceramic sensors, graphite sheets, sintered brake pads, diesel particulate filter (DPF), and antibacterial products. Further, the company provides analytical testing services, including chemical and X-ray fluorescence analysis, flame absorption spectrophotometer, carbon analysis, silicon carbide analysis, ignition loss, pH value measurement, x-ray diffraction, field emission scanning electron microscope (FE-SEM), Hg porosity measurement, N2-BET surface area measurement, thermal expansion and conductivity measurement, thermogravimetry-differential thermal analysis, and particle size distribution measurement with laser micro track methods; and engine test bench services. Additionally, it is involved in manufacture, development, and sale of porcelain products and certain construction materials for aesthetic purposes; development of technology for the utilization of industrial waste; and exploitation and sales of industrial materials. The company serves steelmaking, nonferrous metal, cement, ceramics, chemicals, electric instruments, construction, machinery, and civil engineering industries. TYK Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
